### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of breaded fried chicken pieces, Caesar-style salad, broccoli, and a small cheese-topped pizza or flatbread piece.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **27 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas are approximate, with overlapping salad ingredients assigned separate footprint shares. Dressing is counted separately by visible coating, not as extra plate coverage.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Romaine lettuce | 29% | 166 cm² × 2.5 cm = 415 ml | 0.15 | 62 g | 17 | 11 |
| Breaded fried chicken | 25% | 143 cm² × 1.5 cm = 215 ml | 0.90 | 193 g | 280 | 540 |
| Cooked broccoli | 12% | 69 cm² × 2 cm = 138 ml | 0.60 | 83 g | 35 | 29 |
| Cheese pizza/flatbread piece | 9% | 51 cm² × 1.3 cm = 66 ml | 0.90 | 60 g | 270 | 162 |
| Croutons | 2% | 11 cm² × 2 cm = 22 ml | 0.40 | 9 g | 410 | 37 |
| Parmesan shavings | 1% | 6 cm² × 0.6 cm = 3.6 ml | 1.00 | 4 g | 430 | 17 |
| Creamy salad dressing | Coating | Approximately 18 ml | 1.00 | 18 g | 450 | 81 |

**Coverage check:** 29 + 25 + 12 + 9 + 2 + 1 = **78%** of the plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **429 g and 877 kcal** is plausible for this plate: chicken contributes most of the weight and energy, while the bulky lettuce contributes relatively little weight. The largest uncertainties are the chicken’s breading/oil content and the partially cropped cheese-topped piece.
